itens.trecho: Uma excelente sequência. Este filme é a adaptação do segundo livro da saga de Harry Potter, escrito por J.K. Rowling, e deu seguimento à franquia. Tal como no primeiro filme, é dirigido por Chris Columbus e mantém quase o mesmo elenco e equipa técnica.

Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets is a worthy sequel that improves upon the first and expands the lore in a grand way. The quality in this film is vastly superior to the first in terms of CGI and acting, which is par for the course as the main trio grows into their roles and as actors.

This second book in JK Rowling's "Harry Potter" series sees our trio of wizarding weans start to develop a much closer relationship with each other; and we begin to realise the challenges young "Harry" (Daniel Radcliffe) is to face as he grows up.
